capture_source: live capture 2026-06-26 via Wireshark on enp111s0; SAP A4H sysnr=00 port=3300
evidence: NI read path (4B NI header confirmed); GW header structure pending protocol analysis
notes: RFC_MARKER 00000001 = server response (vs ffff0001 for client request)
GW header bytes 14-75 differ from client: contain session info, client number, codepage
Tag 0x0514 = 16B session token (includes client MAC + session data)

Tag 0x0667 = 8B float64 LE = 74.0 = 74 microseconds of server-side time for this call. Settled by probing RFC_PING_AND_WAIT, which sleeps a known interval and returns a constant-size reply: the value tracked the sleep to 0.1% as microseconds while the response size never moved. The timeout reading recorded here previously is disproven. See docs/protocol/framing.md.
CHAR params are fixed-width 255 chars (510 bytes UTF-16LE), space-padded
